source_domain: P=ports[(profiles&4)==0,:16], indices0..30959, distinct source and target register pools
target_buckets: all14670 distinct packed17bit labels, ordered numerically; bucket members are actual target ports with that label
helper_index: h(s,b) for every source port s and target label bucket b with parity(p_s&b)=0
coefficient: C(t,s)=delta(t,s)-(q^3-4q)/48 where q=(P_t dot P_s)/4; on indexed helper incidences q is odd and delta=0

phases.for_each: helper h(s,b), each target t in bucket b

phases.legality: p_s dot b=0, so span(p_s) is contained in cap(b)

phases.optional_fused_K_hook: All sources are FULL and all targets remain zero; scalar compensation helper payloads are held at their target-bucket caps. Run an independently specified full-center K encoder and its paid FULL->zero restored copies while every target stays at zero.
phases.scope: The K hook is not a free primitive. Its816center roles, width17 center-copy descents, bank stock, pads and encoder costs belong to the caller invoice and proof. Omitting this phase yields the standalone I-K compensation shear.

phases.for_each: helper h(s,b), each target t in bucket b

arbitrary_dirt_identity: Each lane has initial independent dirt d. Its target contribution is -C*d atzero plus C*(d+source_s) atcap, exactly C*source_s. AtFULL the lane subtracts source_s and returns exactly d.
inverse_transpose_identity: In the same event order the dual precompensation adds C*target_t to h; dual gather subtracts h from source_s; dual scatter subtracts C*target_t from h; dual cleanup adds the restored h to source_s. Helper dirt cancels and source_s receives -sum_t C(t,s)*target_t.
